Uniform diffuse illumination; no cast shadows, highlights, vignette, perspective, body parts, skin gaps, text, labels, borders or watermark. This will be retinted with anatomically placed species markings, so keep colour neutral and contrast restrained. Dense fine fibres should read as soft fur when tiled at small physical scale. Seamless on all four edges. Save at high detail.
use: Fine coat colour variation combined with anatomy-placed markings; not a measured height map.
normal_source: Tangent-space baking from the supplied high-resolution STL sculpt, not AI-generated normals.
